author: Retro Game Corps
description:
The new TrimUI Brick Pro is the bigger brother of the OG Brick, with a couple nice upgrades like a bigger screen and battery, and analog sticks. At the same time, it loses a bit of magic compared to the original.

Buy one here: https://tidd.ly/3T6Rl36
Use code RGC15 for 15% off
